findings.finding: Both Notion sync steps skipped because the integration token and respective data-source secrets are not configured/evidenced and sharing of both databases with the same integration has not been demonstrated.
findings.disposition: Share the Terminology Registry and Roadmap & Evaluation Ledger with one Notion integration; configure NOTION_API_TOKEN, NOTION_GLOSSARY_DATA_SOURCE_ID and NOTION_SDGDS_ROADMAP_DATA_SOURCE_ID as repository Actions secrets; verify create/update/no-op reconciliation.

findings.finding: The registry contains 25 initial seed terms; the denominator for all terminology in approved HSMART and Hypersystem-Orchestrator sources is unknown.
findings.disposition: Define an approved repository/path inventory, run a bounded discovery pilot, deduplicate against IDs/aliases, and keep machine-extracted candidates Proposed until reviewed.

findings.finding: Verified individual expert perspectives have not been populated for the seed because attributable primary sources have not been validated.
findings.disposition: Maintain the no-fabrication rule. Add expert views only with traceable author, work, context and source; add authoritative external specifications for protocol/standard definitions.

findings.finding: The canonical progress JSON supports multiple evidence URLs per work item, but the Notion roadmap sync currently writes only the first URL to the single Evidence URL property. Additional evidence remains in GitHub JSON but is not surfaced in Notion row properties.
findings.disposition: Add an Additional Evidence URLs rich-text property or a normalized evidence relation, update the sync contract, and verify full evidence parity.

findings.finding: The roadmap validator enforces key semantic constraints in Python, while CI does not currently execute the complete JSON Schema against the ledger. Some schema/validator drift could remain undetected.
findings.disposition: Add a pinned JSON Schema validation step with positive and negative fixtures, or prove parity with a comprehensive test harness.

findings.finding: No accountable SDGDS implementation/maintenance owner, capacity or approved target schedule is recorded.
findings.disposition: GOV-01 records an accountable execution/maintenance role and capacity baseline before creating delivery commitments. Do not infer owner from the PRE agent or AI reviewer.

limitations: This is a correlation-limited AI assurance review, not independent model/provider certification.
GOV-11 is a designated logical profile but is not provisioned as a separate execution runtime.
The same assistant conversation participated in implementation and review; the review is not organizationally independent.
CI validates the current glossary/roadmap validator behavior and tests; the full JSON Schema is not yet executed by a dedicated JSON Schema validation step.
Both Notion sync jobs explicitly skipped because credentials/data-source access are not configured/evidenced; no automated sync success is claimed.
The 25-term seed is not a complete ecosystem inventory. User comprehension, lookup efficiency and adoption impact have not been measured.
No SDGDS production service, autonomous discovery crawler or dedicated search API/MCP endpoint is deployed.

The Notion saved-view readback verifies 25 terminology entries, one Proposed review item, 20 roadmap ledger rows, 12 milestones and 4 risks. The separate workspace Query Data Source allowance was exhausted, so faithful row-level readback was performed through saved views instead.
Authenticated Notion sync was not exercised; CI step results explicitly show skipped for both databases because secrets are absent.
disposition: The reviewed PR change set is acceptable with caveats as the SDGDS terminology and progressive-roadmap foundation: the canonical terminology and roadmap ledgers, schemas, validators, glossary renderer, 13 unit tests and four technical/governance workflow groups pass on the exact reviewed snapshot. The fifth group is the report-binding gate and correctly requested this refreshed exact-SHA report; its final report-only validation is pending. The roadmap remains PROPOSED_NOT_FROZEN; PR #29 remains subject to GOV-01 disposition. Configure and verify both Notion sync paths, add full JSON Schema execution in CI, expose all evidence URLs in Notion, and assign an accountable owner before claiming operational automation. Keep merge authority exclusively with GOV-01.
